note: After Emerson (1925)'s description of a single alate from Georgetown, British Guiana (in English); the original states 'This description is taken from a single winged imago', being based on a single alate only, with the soldier and worker not described. Emerson considered it to agree with the original description of Banks (1918, p. 659). Measurements: body length with wings 14.00 mm, without wings 8.00 mm, head length 1.83 mm, head width 1.57 mm, antennal length 2.25 mm, eye diameter 0.64 mm, pronotum length 0.80 mm, width 1.57 mm, hind tibia 1.35 mm, fore wing 10.25 mm long, 2.95 mm wide. Type locality Taboga Island, Panama; new record Georgetown, British Guiana.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head red-yellow, short, broadly oval, with several rather long setae. Antennae 17-segmented, segment 2 larger than segment 3, segment 3 as long as segment 4. Compound eyes large, the distance from the lower margin of the head slightly less than their width (0.19 mm); anterior margin rounded. Ocelli very close to the compound eyes, oval. Pronotum concolorous with the head, about as wide as the head. Arolia distinct. Wings yellowish brown, transparent; costa, radius, subcosta and media distinct; cubitus not very distinct, with 11—14 branches, the venation very similar to that of K. kartaboensis. Abdominal tergites yellow.
